claim: 21st.dev: community component marketplace; llms.txt claims 12,000+ catalog; MCP endpoint at POST /api/mcp returns JSON-RPC 401 'Not authenticated - your API key is missing', proving a live authenticated MCP; free tier metered ~2 installs/day; community-submitted refresh; shadcn-format registry.
limitations: Catalog size is a vendor claim, not parsed. Our local snapshot of it is 7,949 (observed). Terms prohibit scraping/bots and republishing structured metadata (fetched 2026-07-20 in prior lane).
rank_rationale: Largest catalog we already hold a 7,949-component snapshot of; its MCP + metering is the exact rate constraint P05 must design around.

claim: shadcn registry.json spec + registry MCP: the de-facto machine-readable interchange for this category. `shadcn mcp init` works against any shadcn-compatible registry. Dynamic Search spec (apps/v4/content/docs/registry/dynamic-search.mdx, read via gh api by this lane) defines GET /r/registry.json?q=&type=&limit=&offset= with a `pagination` object as the opt-in server-side-search signal.
limitations: A spec, not a catalog. Adoption breadth across registries is inferred from multiple registries serving registry.json, not exhaustively enumerated.
rank_rationale: A shipped, backwards-compatible contract for agent query over a large corpus — removes the need to invent P05's agent API.

claim: registry.directory (beta): curated cross-registry aggregator with freshness telemetry. Server-rendered page yielded a 'Just shipped' feed with per-registry new-component deltas dated same-day (Shadcn Blocks +193, Zyeon UI +121, ReUI +93, Shadcn Space +62, UIAble +48), 35 'N items' badges, per-registry updated-recency (6 registries updated same-day; others 4d/6d/21d; some stale 7mo/10mo), capability badges incl. mcp/pro blocks/templates/figma, and human-written editorial groupings.
limitations: Beta. Counts are as-rendered on one fetch, not re-derived from each registry. Claim of 88 external registries in shadcn repo and a 40+ registry MCP is UNVERIFIED.
rank_rationale: The nearest existing implementation of P05's own thesis: cross-source freshness telemetry plus editorial-over-machine taxonomy.

claim: The Component Gallery: 60 canonical components each carrying an explicit alias list, across 95 design systems. Aliases observed verbatim incl. Accordion -> Collapse/Disclosure/Expandable/ShowyHideyThing; Badge -> Tag/Label/Chip; Drawer -> Tray/Flyout/Sheet. Design-system facets carry live counts: Platform GitHub 70/Figma 23/Storybook 23; Tech React 50/Sass 22/Web Components 20; Features Code examples 79/Open source 69/Unmaintained 11/Accessibility issues 4. Manual curation via contact form; no API/export/llms.txt.
limitations: 403 to direct WebFetch; retrieved via r.jina.ai proxy. A quoted '2,676 examples' figure could NOT be confirmed from source and is UNVERIFIED. Per-component page structure not yet confirmed.
rank_rationale: Empirically falsifies a flat tag vocabulary: Banner/Stepper/Label each appear as BOTH a canonical name and an alias of a different canonical, so a flat namespace collides.

claim: Mobbin: hand-curated real-app screenshots. Four search dimensions: Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshots. Official hosted MCP at https://api.mobbin.com/mcp returning inline images + metadata, 60 req/min, default 20 screens/call, paid-plan OAuth-enforced, beta. Weekly curation.
limitations: 403 direct. Scale figures conflict across sources (621,500 screens/142,200 flows from its own MCP launch vs '600,000+/300,000+' vs older '405,800/81,700'); at most one is right. Designer-count claims contradict. All scale UNVERIFIED except as attributed claims.
rank_rationale: Only verified first-party production MCP serving a visual corpus to agents; its image-context cost (3-8 per call) is a real constraint for P05's agent surface.

claim: Creative Tim UI: llms.txt is 72,531 bytes, claims '435+ blocks'; 418 distinct /ui/r/{name}.json block URLs extracted from it; two fetched (banner-01, hero-01) were valid registry:block items with categories and meta. Ships a CLI and an agent skill (npx skills add creativetimofficial/ui). PRO blocks need an API key.
limitations: 435+ is a vendor claim; 418 is what was actually extracted. Only 2 of 418 endpoints were fetched.
rank_rationale: Most complete verified agent stack (llms.txt + registry URLs + CLI + agent skill) and proof the pattern is retrofittable.

claim: ReactBits registry.json parsed to 672 items (name=@react-bits) — the largest single registry actually parsed in this run. Tailark parsed to 469 (name=Tailark Base UI).
limitations: Registry item count includes demos/examples and is NOT a component count. Licence/terms not assessed by this lane.
rank_rationale: Largest verified per-integration corpus yield; establishes that registry item count != component count, a trap for any corpus sizing.

claim: UIverse: 4,456 UI elements extracted from the live /elements page. Community-submitted, continuous refresh. Categories (Buttons/Checkboxes/Cards/Loaders) plus style tag facets (#neumorphism, #3d, #gradient), sort/filter, per-author attribution. Strong visual browse for non-technical users. No agent access found: /llms.txt 404, /api/elements 404.
limitations: Agent-access absence verified only for two probed paths.
rank_rationale: The clearest verified case of strong human visual browse with zero agent access — the exact gap P05 claims to fill.

claim: Awwwards: deepest verified multi-facet scheme. Facets include award level, ~27 industry categories, style tags (3D, Minimal, Parallax, Microinteractions), technology (React, GSAP, Three.js, WebGL, Webflow), 100+ countries, font name, and hex colour-swatch filtering.
limitations: Indexes whole sites, not components. No dedupe or agent access observed.
rank_rationale: Colour-swatch and font filtering are the best verified answer to 'client chooses without knowing component names'.

claim: Adele (UXPin): ~35-column comparison matrix over design systems in five groups (Basics, Engineering, Design assets, Content & guidance, Documentation & delivery), sortable/filterable, cells deep-linked to source docs. Includes a 'color naming convention' facet with enum natural/abstract/branded/specific.
limitations: Page truncated on fetch: >=85 systems visible, true total UNVERIFIED. GitHub source exists but repo not reached; refresh cadence unknown.
rank_rationale: Rare instance of a catalog encoding naming philosophy itself as a facet — directly informs P05's taxonomy decision.

claim: Aceternity UI registry.json parsed to 278 items; /ai-recommendations page self-describes as machine-readable catalog of 111 free + 23 pro components, 17 templates, 167 pro blocks, 1 hooks; llms.txt points there.
limitations: Homepage claims '200+' while its own AI page says 111 free + 23 pro — claim/reality gap.
